headline: Senior Software Engineer | Ex-Finance Professional
summary: Results-oriented software engineer with a unique background in financial services. Successfully pivoted from a banking career to full-stack development, bringing strong analytical rigor and a deep understanding of fintech systems to software engineering challenges.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Lead the development of microservices for mobile payment gateways, processing over 100,000 daily transactions.
Optimized database performance for high-concurrency payment processing, reducing latency by 30%.
Mentored junior developers and conducted code reviews to ensure adherence to high-security coding standards.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
description: Developed and maintained RESTful APIs for cloud-based enterprise solutions using Java and Spring Boot.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate third-party banking APIs.
Implemented automated testing frameworks, increasing code coverage from 40% to 85%.

experiences.title: Financial Analyst
description: Managed portfolio risks and performed quantitative analysis on lending products.
Automated manual reporting processes using Excel VBA and SQL, saving approximately 15 hours of manual work per week.
Identified the potential for banking software optimization, which catalyzed the transition to a technical career path.

educations.degree: Master of Science in Computer Science
